zh.title: DHL接收首架Mammoth改裝波音777貨機
zh.summary: DHL已接收其首架經Mammoth改裝之波音777貨機，據稱具備原廠貨機性能。
body: 物流營運商DHL已正式接收其首架經由Mammoth進行改裝的波音777貨機。這架改裝廣體貨機的加入，代表著該公司在擴充全球貨運機隊方面取得最新的進展。
根據報導內容，這架經由Mammoth進行客機改貨機轉換的波音777機型，據稱能夠提供與波音原廠建造之777F貨機相符的性能與載重能力。
這項改裝方案主打能以原廠新建造貨機僅一小部分的成本費用，達成與原廠新機相近的營運表現，為物流市場提供兼具成本效益與運能的貨機選擇。

en.title: DHL Receives First Mammoth-Converted Boeing 777 Freighter
en.summary: DHL takes delivery of its first Mammoth-converted Boeing 777 freighter offering factory-level cargo performance.
body: Global logistics operator DHL has officially taken delivery of its first Boeing 777 freighter converted by Mammoth. The arrival of this newly converted widebody freighter marks an important addition to the logistics operator's global air transport operations.

According to reporting on the aircraft delivery, the Mammoth-converted Boeing 777 freighter is reported to match the flight capabilities and cargo performance of an original factory-built Boeing 777F freighter.

The converted freighter model provides air cargo operators with a high-capacity widebody solution, offering performance comparable to factory-built Boeing 777F aircraft at a fraction of the original equipment cost.

zh.title: Simple Flying：川普將搭乘前卡達波音747-8客機前往海外
zh.summary: 川普擬搭前卡達波音747-8前往海外；飛機具未證實安全升級與反制措施
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 5 日的報導，唐納·川普（Donald Trump）預計將搭乘一架前卡達波音 747-8 客機飛往海外。報導指出，該架飛機配備了未經證實的安全升級措施。
這架被指為贈與的波音 747-8 飛機在秘密換機與未經證實的反制措施背景下前往海外。相關未經證實的安全反制措施與飛機調換安排，已讓相關航空專家感到不安。
目前關於該架波音 747-8 飛機的安全升級與反制措施具體內容仍未獲官方證實，相關秘密換機行動的詳細細節亦未進一步公開。

en.title: Trump Scheduled To Fly Overseas On Ex-Qatari Boeing 747-8 With Security Upgrades
en.summary: Donald Trump plans to fly overseas on an ex-Qatari Boeing 747-8 with unconfirmed security upgrades.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 5, 2026, Donald Trump is scheduled to fly overseas aboard a Boeing 747-8 aircraft. The aircraft was previously operated by Qatar and features unconfirmed security upgrades.

The gifted Boeing 747-8 is departing for overseas operations amid secret plane swaps and unconfirmed countermeasures. These unconfirmed security enhancements and aircraft switch arrangements have reportedly caused concern, leaving industry experts uneasy about the flight.
Details regarding the specific nature of the security upgrades and countermeasures remain unconfirmed, while information regarding the plane swaps has not been officially detailed.

zh.title: 巴西航空工業交付第2000架EJet予AzulLinhasAéreas
zh.summary: 巴西航空工業交付2000架E195-E2；Azul Linhas Aéreas接收
body: 巴西航空工業宣布交付第2000架E-Jet，該架飛機為E195-E2型號，交付給巴西最大航空公司Azul Linhas Aéreas。
巴西航空工業商用航空總裁兼CEO Arjan Meijer表示：「第2000架E-Jet的交付對巴西航空工業及全球航空運輸產業而言是非凡的里程碑。」
Azul Linhas Aéreas為巴西航點最多的航空公司，已營運超過140架E-Jet，並為E195-E2的啟動客戶，於2019年接收首架。
E-Jet家族為現役第三大交付商用噴射機家族，僅次於空中巴士A320家族及波音737家族。E2系列累積訂單532架（E195-E2 464架、E190-E2 68架），已交付約175架E195-E2及38架E190-E2，剩餘約319架訂單。
E-Jet家族自2004年投入服務，服務超過90家航空公司、60個國家，累積飛行時數約4800萬小時，載客逾28.5億人次。競爭對手方面，空中巴士A220訂單1106架、交付532架、積壓574架；空中巴士A330neo積壓334架；中國商飛C919估計訂單逾千架；波音787訂單2927架、交付1299架。
旗艦機型E195-E2宣稱航程3000海里、最大單艙座位146席。最大營運商為Porter Airlines，其次為Azul Linhas Aéreas及KLM Cityhopper。

en.title: Embraer Delivers 2,000th E-Jet, an E195-E2, to Azul Linhas Aéreas
en.summary: Embraer delivers 2,000th E-Jet E195-E2 to Azul Linhas Aéreas; milestone marks third most delivered jet family
body: Embraer announced the delivery of its 2,000th E-Jet, an E195-E2, to Brazil's largest airline Azul Linhas Aéreas.
Arjan Meijer, President and CEO of Embraer Commercial Aviation, said: "The delivery of the 2,000th E-Jet is an extraordinary milestone for Embraer and for the global aviation transport industry."

Azul Linhas Aéreas is Brazil's largest airline by number of destinations served and operates more than 140 E-Jets. It was the launch customer for the E195-E2, taking delivery of the first aircraft in 2019.

The E-Jet family is now the third most delivered commercial jet family still in production, after the Airbus A320 family and the Boeing 737 family. The E2 series has accumulated 532 orders (464 for the E195-E2 and 68 for the E190-E2), with around 175 E195-E2s and 38 E190-E2s delivered, leaving a backlog of roughly 319 aircraft.

Since entering service in 2004, the E-Jet fleet serves more than 90 airlines in over 60 countries, logging about 48 million flight hours and carrying over 2.85 billion passengers. In comparison, the Airbus A220 has 1,106 orders with 532 deliveries and a 574-aircraft backlog; the Airbus A330neo has a backlog of 334; COMAC's C919 is estimated to have over 1,000 orders; and the Boeing 787 has 2,927 orders with 1,299 deliveries. The flagship E195-E2 offers a range of 3,000 nautical miles and a maximum single-class seating of 146. Porter Airlines is the largest E195-E2 operator, followed by Azul Linhas Aéreas and KLM Cityhopper.

zh.title: 衣索比亞航空洽購最多10架波音777貨機
zh.summary: 傳聞洽購8至10架777貨機；兩公司未置評
body: 路透社2日報導，埃塞俄比亞航空（Ethiopian Airlines）接近達成協議，向波音購買最多10架長程貨機。報導指出，此潛在訂單預期包括兩架現役波音777F，其餘可能由新一代777-8F組成。
兩名業界消息人士向路透社透露，協議最終可能涵蓋8至10架飛機，具體組合仍可能變動。波音與埃塞俄比亞航空均未立即置評。
埃塞俄比亞航空目前營運12架777F、3架波音767貨機及4架改裝的737貨機。公司2025年處理約897,000公噸貨運，較前一年增加16%。
報導亦提及，波音因應2028年生效的排放法規，計劃於2027年底停產777F，並已向美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）請求核准額外生產35架777F。

en.title: Ethiopian Airlines in talks for up to 10 Boeing 777 freighters
en.summary: Reported order may cover 8-10 aircraft; firms declined comment
body: Reuters reported on 2 September that Ethiopian Airlines is nearing a deal to buy up to 10 long-haul freighters from Boeing. The intended order is expected to include two current-generation Boeing 777Fs, with the remainder potentially made up of the newer 777-8F.
Two industry sources told Reuters the deal could cover eight to 10 aircraft, with the exact composition subject to change. Neither Boeing nor Ethiopian Airlines immediately commented on the report.

Ethiopian Airlines operates 12 777Fs, along with three Boeing 767 freighters and four converted 737 freighters. Its cargo business handled around 897,000 metric tons of freight in 2025, a 16% increase from the prior year.

The report also noted that Boeing, facing emissions rules taking effect in 2028, plans to end 777F production at the end of 2027 and has asked the FAA for permission to build 35 additional 777Fs beyond the deadline.
